key.name: enabled
key.description: Whether this provider is active. Order and visibility are kept while it is disabled.

key.name: executable-path
key.description: Absolute path to the provider CLI. Empty uses automatic discovery.

key.name: top-bar-quota
key.description: Which quota percentage to show in the top bar.

key.name: show-plan
key.description: Whether the menu shows the subscription plan when the provider reports one.

key.name: show-billing
key.description: Whether the menu shows billing amounts when the provider reports them.

key.name: icon-url
key.description: HTTPS URL for this provider icon. Empty uses the built-in default.

key.name: allow-unofficial-sources
key.description: Allow this provider to read a local CLI session and call an unofficial usage endpoint. Off by default.
